Cooking Connection demo-counter interior (staff inside the horseshoe). The pipeline cannot condemn this pocket itself, but NOT because the name is artwork: 'Cooking' (981.5,310.8) and 'Connection' (978.6,314.7) are ordinary text spans that page.get_text('words') returns. engine.SERVICE_DEPTS carries a 'COOKING' token, yet extract.py's anchor whitelist has no COOKING entry, so no anchor is ever named COOKING and the substring cull never fires — the token is dead on the vector path (raster.py's MAJOR_LABELS omits it too)

Meal Simple prep interior (staff inside the horseshoe; its only floor links are two ~2 pt slivers past the block at x=985-1005 — cf. 659's 'Meal Simple seating/prep block' exclusion). Same dead-token cause as the Cooking Connection entry: 'Meal' (986.8,466.7) and 'Simple' (983.9,473.6) are ordinary text spans, but extract.py's whitelist has no MEAL entry, so SERVICE_DEPTS' 'MEAL SIMPLE' token never matches an anchor. Note the two words also land in different line buckets (round(y0/4) = 116 vs 118), so the phrase 'MEAL SIMPLE' never forms — a whitelist fix would have to match 'MEAL'
